title: The Godly Man's Double Standard
caption:
A godly man judges himself first. Everyone else gets the grace.

Most guys have it backwards: hard on everyone else, soft on their own stuff. Flip it. Name your sin before you name his. Give him the excuse you never give yourself. Keep conviction between you and God, not the group chat. Confess before you correct.

That's not weakness. That's the double standard a godly man is supposed to run.

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
